Description: Workshop Customizer add-ons: target contract, fixed SSM documents, applier install and least-privilege sync/run policy.

WorkshopStackName.Description: Name of the upstream workshop stack (exports SkillsBucketName).

WorkshopInstanceId.Description: InstanceId output of the workshop stack (the students' EC2).

TemplateCommit.Description: Pinned upstream commit every synced release must declare.

Properties.Name: /workshop-customizer/target-contract
Properties.Description: Workshop Customizer target contract — trust anchor read by the App before any SendCommand.

Content.description: Workshop Customizer: install the release applier and target contract on the workshop EC2.

runCommand: if ! /usr/bin/python3.12 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y python3.12 python3.12-pip; fi
aws ssm get-parameter --region '{{ Region }}' --name '{{ ContractParameterName }}' --query Parameter.Value --output text > /etc/workshop-customizer/target.json.tmp
runuser -u '{{ TargetUser }}' -- /usr/bin/python3.12 -m pip install --user boto3 botocore retrying uv

Content.description: Workshop Customizer: apply, commit, roll back or inspect a verified release on the workshop EC2. Parameters are typed and pattern-constrained; the document only invokes the applier pre-installed by the WorkshopCustomizerAddons stack and never executes caller-supplied shell.

WatchdogMinutes.description: Minutes before an uncommitted release is rolled back automatically (apply only)

Reason.description: Free-text reason recorded in the deployment manifest (rollback)

runCommand: test -f /opt/workshop-customizer/apply_release.py || { echo 'applier not installed; deploy the WorkshopCustomizerAddons stack first' >&2; exit 90; }
test -f /etc/workshop-customizer/target.json || { echo 'target contract missing; refusing' >&2; exit 91; }

exec /usr/bin/python3 /opt/workshop-customizer/apply_release.py --action '{{ Action }}' --source '{{ SourceUri }}' --sha256 '{{ ExpectedSha256 }}' --version '{{ ExpectedVersion }}' --watchdog-minutes '{{ WatchdogMinutes }}' --reason '{{ Reason }}'

Content.description: Workshop Customizer: run exactly one allow-listed upstream Workshop Guide step against the active, release-bound tree. The caller cannot supply shell code or paths.

Script.description: Canonical script paired with StepId; the document verifies the pair before execution

runCommand: test "$EXPECTED_SCRIPT" = '{{ Script }}' || { echo '{"status":"failed","error":"step/script pair mismatch"}'; exit 93; }
test -n "$EXPECTED_DIR" && test "$CURRENT_DIR" = "$EXPECTED_DIR" || { echo '{"status":"failed","error":"requested release is not active"}'; exit 94; }
test -x "$RELEASE_DIR/$EXPECTED_SCRIPT" || { echo '{"status":"failed","error":"allow-listed script is missing or not executable"}'; exit 95; }
